scope: Classical gauge-link holonomy memory under actual vacancy transport; not quantum statistics or braid amplitudes.

algebra.scope: Classical fixed ordered D4 holonomy tuples modulo simultaneous conjugation; not a count of all torus connections or quantum fusion states.
algebra.pure_action: Pair generators commute and square to identity; noncommuting flux group does not imply noncommuting pure-winding actions.
algebra.orbit_formula: For quotient rank below two: 1. Otherwise 2^(n-3) if the total quotient is zero, and 2^(n-2) otherwise; n counts noncentral entries.
